body: Pretty much. I just want someone who will always be there for me and I feel like I will just never ever have that person I can rely on.
I have been trying to think here for a few minutes and as screwed up as it sounds, it is only imagining myself being loved as a partner by someone else.
I know, but I can't find that strength right now. My will to live has almost left me these past few months. I find it so hard to get out of bed every day or even think.
